provider: Native Java implementation of the continuous ComBat equations and source rules; no upstream R code included
source_conventions: original 1e-4 tolerance and signed relative-change denominator
global missing-data branch uses sample residual variance
direct original nonparametric likelihood arithmetic; preserve undefined values
first-occurrence levels correspond to explicitly supplying those factor levels in R
zero within-batch variance rows retained without adjustment; effect placeholders are not estimated
nonparametric_transcendentals: Java StrictMath pow/exp for deterministic original-formula evaluation; reference agreement is numerical, not R-libm bitwise identity
missing_variance_propagation: Unavailable R sample variances remain missing in original likelihood sums; the complete batch-design product preserves zero times missing/NaN propagation
zero_variance_screen: Uniform represented constants and numerically zero sample variances both retain the original row
undefined_representation: Supplied NA remains NA. Java Double.NaN represents derived R NA and NaN; derived undefined output cells export as NaN. The full nonfinite mask and refusal outcome are compared, without claiming R payload/token identity.
